shortBulletSummary: Crypto Fear & Greed Index currently stands at 45 (Neutral).
Bitcoin price rose ~1% to $82k in 24hrs, supported by China's GDP exceeding forecasts.
Spot Bitcoin ETFs continue to experience net outflows, signaling weakening institutional demand.
Persistent US inflation concerns and upcoming CPI data fuel fears of potential Fed rate hikes.
Ongoing geopolitical tensions, particularly US-Iran dynamics and Ukraine conflict, weigh on risk appetite.
